Associate Software Engineer

Marrow Labs is a small team building infrastructure for genomics research. We
are looking for our fourth engineer.

The person we hire will spend most of their time writing Python. Our backend is
a FastAPI service talking to Postgres, deployed on AWS, and we care a great deal
about correctness because our users are running analyses that take days. You
should be comfortable reading code you did not write and asking why it exists
before changing it. We expect you to write tests; we do not expect you to have
written them at scale before.

We are not looking for a specific number of years of experience. We are looking
for someone who has built something real and can explain the decisions they made
while building it. That could be a job, an internship, a research project or a
side project that people actually use.

You must be comfortable with Python and SQL. You must be able to work
independently, because we are remote and asynchronous, and nobody will be
checking on you hourly. Experience with AWS, Docker or Kubernetes is genuinely
useful but we will teach it if you have not touched it.

Familiarity with bioinformatics is a nice bonus and absolutely not a requirement.
Most of our team came from ordinary web backgrounds.
